Policies · Privacy

Privacy.

This page describes what the site actually stores. No analytics, advertising or customer database is connected, so the list is short.

What is stored in your browser

aura_cart_v1 holds the items in your cart. aura_wishlist_v1 holds saved product ids. aura_order_requests_v1 holds invoice requests: reference, date, items, name, email, delivery address and any note you add. aura_newsletter_v1 holds a newsletter address if you enter one. All of it stays on your device until you clear it.

What is not stored here

No card number, security code or bank login. No analytics identifier and no advertising profile. The site does not transmit this browser storage anywhere.

When a server is connected

Lawful basis, retention, the processors used for email and payment, your rights of access and erasure, and how to complain to a supervisory authority will be published before any of those systems go live.

This notice will be replaced by the full policy before a server-side account, mailing service or payment provider is connected.
